sentences.en: The children cavorted in the park, running and playing games.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在公园里欢跃，跑来跑去玩游戏。

sentences.en: She loves to cavort around the city on her day off.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢在休息日逛城市。

sentences.en: They cavorted with joy at their reunion after many years apart.
sentences.zh: 多年不见后，他们在团聚时欢喜地嬉戏。
